blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) has sought Meta’s assistance in identifying the people behind at least 30 social media accounts that allegedly mocked the disability and sexual orientation of Akbayan Rep. Percival Cendaña, NBI Director Melvin Matibag said. The move followed Cendaña’s Sept. 15 complaint asking the NBI to investigate the accounts, […]...
